review_state.title: Automate US Digital Marketing: The Founder's Blueprint
review_state.description: US founders: stop wasting budget on manual marketing. This blueprint shows you exactly what to audit, automate, and approve to scale digital marketing efficiently.
review_state.preview_text: Most founders don't have a marketing problem. They have a systems problem dressed up as a marketing problem. The campaigns exist. The content gets published. The ad spend goes out. But nothing compounds, nothing scales, and every week the team is back to square one doing the same manual work.
